problem:
y > 3x - 7
2x + y <= 12
Which of the following points (x, y) is a solution to the given system of inequalities?

bad.why: Substituting four points into two inequalities by hand is eight sign-sensitive checks; the shaded overlap shows the answer at a glance.

algebraFirst.description: Substitutes each of the four points into both inequalities by hand, eight sign-sensitive checks.

explanationNotes: Explain that a solution must make both inequalities true at once, which on the graph is the region where the two shadings overlap; only (2, 5) lies inside it. Mention that a dashed boundary (from >) is not included while a solid one (from <=) is.
